# Element Count Calculation

Source: [4857](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4857); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4857-n1"></a>

- Documented base costs: rule/action/condition/default value/default literal 1; Array, Workshop Settings, Evaluate Once, localized string 2; more specific component cost overrides generic cost.

<a id="wiki-4857-n2"></a>

- Comments, custom-game settings and rule event/team/player parameters contribute no elements.

<a id="wiki-4857-n3"></a>

- Disabling rules/actions/conditions does not reduce element count.

<a id="wiki-4857-n4"></a>

- Every top-level action/condition argument receives a one-element discount.

<a id="wiki-4857-n5"></a>

- Hero-literal pairs nested inside top-level action/condition arguments add elements; direct Action(Ana,Zenyatta) is documented as exempt, while nested Array(Ana,Zenyatta) incurs one. The separate nested-argument example also incurs a hero-pair element.

<a id="wiki-4857-n6"></a>

- Article derives its counting model from Zezombye's OverPy element-saving wiki, making this a cross-source reference rather than an independent validation.

Source limitations:

- The nested-hero adjustment wording is subtle; retain examples and check actual compiler/game counts before simplifying it.

- Rules are 'at time of writing'; November 2024 metadata is not an explicit patch validation.

- Worked-example source code is only in remote images, although prose describes its costs.
